task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the left arm to grab the beige mug, rotate it, set it down, then hang the beige mug onto the metallic rack with smooth finish.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂抓住米色杯子，旋转，放下，然后将米色杯子挂在光滑的金属架上。
